mascot:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: transparent master mascot logo for the actual local-first Genshin personal history archive app FurinaChronicle. Make ONE finished, polished standalone logo, no presentation sheet.
Input images: First reference sheet is the primary CHARACTER IDENTITY and DRAWING STYLE reference: seven official Furina chibi stickers. Second reference sheet is POSE AND RECORD-KEEPING PROP guidance only, other characters must NOT appear. Especially take the compact open book composition of 48-12, active writing gesture of 24-09 and 27-16, simplify as needed.
Primary request: Furina from Genshin Impact depicted as an adorable but composed and attentive chronicler, looking toward the viewer while actually writing in a small OPEN journal. Match the official Furina sticker proportions and recognizable features closely: very large head, white bob hair with pale cyan undersides, flowing side-swept bangs, single curled hair antenna, asymmetric light-blue and deep-blue eyes with white highlights, dark cobalt tilted small top hat with delicate gold crown prongs, dark blue Fontaine outfit, small bow, dark gloves. Keep recognizable hat shape but reduce tiny decoration. Warm subtle confident smile, a very slight blush. No tears, crying, shocked or shouting expression.
Composition: square canvas, a single connected compact silhouette, front three-quarter bust. Hat and hair are the upper 70%, prominently open ivory journal forms the broad curved base, clearly connected to both hands. Her right gloved hand holds ONE slim elegant white-and-blue feather quill, nib physically touching the right-hand page, with TWO simple short blue ink strokes on page. Other hand rests gently on the other book edge. Large readable face, unobstructed eyes. Book cover dark cobalt, small restrained gold corner or bookmark. Center entire silhouette, all curl, hat, quill and book inside image with 10% clear padding. Do not crop.
Style: deliberately faithful to the provided OFFICIAL CHIBI STICKER aesthetic, clean dark navy outer line, rounded expressive shapes, white and icy blue hair masses, flat 2D colors with restrained two-tone cel shadows. Refine into an actual app brand mascot rather than a scene illustration. Reduce necklace, ruffles, and hat gold prongs to a few bold meaningful shapes. No photorealism, no 3D, no generic Disney face.
Colors derived from Furina references: navy ink #172950, royal cobalt #3553B7, icy cyan #A9DDF5, pearl white #F6FAFF, restrained warm gold #D8B775, soft ivory pages. Crisp separation and readable at 64px. Thin off-white outer keyline around the entire mascot for dark-background use.
Background: actual transparent alpha, no square, no circle, no background shape, no fake checkerboard.
No letters, no text, no title, no watermark, no extra characters, no sparkles floating outside, no desk, no scenery, no multiple designs. This should be a useful transparent mascot master for FurinaChronicle.

emblem:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: ONE clean standalone compact emblem logo for FurinaChronicle, personal history archive app themed on Furina from Genshin Impact.
Input images are character/style references, not targets to reproduce. Extract Furina's recognizable deep blue small tilted top hat with three simple gold crown-like tips, cool white/cyan curved accent, and the book/writing concept. No other characters.
Primary request: Design a refined compact symbolic mark combining an OPEN JOURNAL as the broad bottom base, Furina's distinctive small cobalt TOP HAT tilted above the book on the upper left, and ONE WHITE AND ICY-BLUE FEATHER QUILL angled down from upper right toward a visible ink stroke on the book's right page. The visual must feel like a single integrated intentional logo for a record-keeping app, not a collage of three objects. Use negative space and consistent thick curves. Hat overlaps book slightly so the entire emblem connects. Keep the hat readable as a hat with a brim and crown, do not turn it into a crown sitting on book. Hat has one small gold-rimmed blue teardrop jewel and three short stylized gold tips, a broad royal-blue band and a single curling cyan-white accent suggesting Furina's hair. No head or face, no person, no hands.
Composition: square canvas. Emblem occupies central 78% with plenty of transparent padding. Book is wide with a dark navy spine and 2 ivory page shapes, no stacks of extra page lines, a subtle cyan lower edge, one small gold bookmark. White feather has a solid navy contour and ONE inner division, no realistic barbs. One navy ink swoosh where nib touches page. The feather and hat do not obscure each other. Keep silhouette simple enough to read at 32px.
Style: graphic FLAT 2D vector-like logo aesthetic, clean large filled shapes, uniform medium-bold dark navy outlines, tiny restrained two-tone shadow only, no gradients, no realistic textures, no glossy 3D, no photorealism. Contemporary playful stationery brand with Fontaine cues. Clean outer contours without speckles or artifacts. No filigree, no ornamental circles, no enclosing badge shape.
Palette from official Furina references: dark navy #172950, cobalt #3553B7, icy cyan #A9DDF5, pearl #F6FAFF, ivory pages, restrained gold #D8B775. Colors should stay clear on light and dark surfaces, with a very thin clean pearl outer keyline.
Background MUST be true transparent alpha. No background color, no fake checkerboard.
No text, no FC monogram, no letters, no watermark, no extra symbols or sparkles, no presentation board, no multiple variants. One final emblem only.
